steps.en: Load a prompt dataset and pick or write a reward function
steps.zh: 加载提示数据集，选用或自写奖励函数

steps.en: Create the trainer with a Hub model id and start training
steps.zh: 用 Hub 模型 id 创建训练器并开训

steps.en: Generates a group of completions per prompt, in-process or via vLLM
steps.zh: 对每个提示生成一组回答，进程内或交给 vLLM

steps.en: Scores them with your rewards and compares each to its group's average
steps.zh: 用你的奖励打分，并与本组平均分比较

steps.en: Takes a gradient step near the reference model, scaled out via Accelerate
steps.zh: 在贴近参考模型的约束下走一步梯度，经 Accelerate 扩展到多卡

value.en: SFT, DPO or GRPO on any transformers model without writing or debugging a training loop
value.zh: 在任意 transformers 模型上跑 SFT、DPO 或 GRPO，不用自己写、自己排查训练循环
